subject: english
title: 八下英语同步章节卷 · Units 1–2
label: Units 1–2 Time to Relax · Stay Healthy
unit: 八下·Units 1–2 Time to Relax / Stay Healthy
source: 人教版八年级下册 Unit 1 Time to Relax、Unit 2 Stay Healthy 话题：业余爱好与放松方式、压力与作息、常见身体不适及建议。语言点：动词不定式（decide / remember / try / too ... to / a way to do / It's ... to do）、make / let / help sb. do、should / had better 提建议、看病交际用语。按八年级单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: My father decided ______ fishing to relax this weekend.
items.exp: decide to do sth. 决定做某事。

items.stem: It's important for us ______ a balance between study and rest.
items.exp: It's＋形容词＋for sb.＋to do sth.，it 是形式主语，真正的主语是不定式。

items.stem:
—What's the matter with you?
—I have a ______. I ate too much junk food last night.
items.exp: 吃了太多垃圾食品，胃疼 stomachache。

items.stem: You look tired. You ______ go to bed early tonight.
items.exp: 提建议用 should（应该）。看起来很累，应该早点睡。

items.stem: I don't know ______ to do after the exams. Do you have any ideas?
items.exp: do 后面缺宾语，用 what to do（做什么）。how to do 后面不能再缺宾语。

items.stem: Listening to music helps me ______ after a long day.
items.exp: help sb. (to) do sth.，后接动词原形或带 to 的不定式。

items.stem:
—I hurt my knee when I was playing football.
—You'd better ______ some ice on it.
items.exp: had better＋动词原形，“最好做某事”。

items.stem: If you feel stressed, why not ______ a walk in the park?
items.exp: Why not do sth.? 提建议，后接动词原形。

items.stem: He was too tired ______ anything after the long trip.
items.exp: too＋形容词＋to do sth.，“太……而不能……”。

items.stem: Eating too many sweets is bad for your ______.
items.exp: 吃太多糖对牙齿不好。

items.stem: Remember ______ the windows when you leave. It's going to rain.
items.exp: remember to do sth. 记得要去做某事（还没做）；remember doing sth. 记得做过某事。

items.stem:
—I've got a headache.
—______ You should lie down and have a rest.
items.exp: 听到别人不舒服，先表示同情：I'm sorry to hear that。

items.stem: Having a hobby is a good way ______ stress.
items.exp: a way to do sth. 做某事的方法，不定式作定语。

items.stem: The doctor told him ______ up smoking.
items.exp: tell sb. to do sth. 告诉某人做某事；give up 放弃。

items.stem: Doing yoga always makes me ______ calm and relaxed.
items.exp: make sb. do sth. 使某人做某事，用动词原形（省略 to 的不定式）。

sections.title: Li Ming Learns to Relax
sections.passage:
Last term, Li Ming felt very stressed. He had too much homework, and he (16) studied until midnight. He often got headaches and couldn't (17) well at night.
One day, his mother noticed that he looked (18). She said, "You need time to relax. Why not try (19) new?" Li Ming decided to join the school running club.
At first, running was hard for him. After only ten minutes, he was out of (20). But he didn't give up. He ran three times a week with his teammates. Slowly, he could run (21) and longer.
Two months later, Li Ming found that he was much healthier. He didn't get headaches any (22), and he slept well. Even his grades went up, (23) his mind was clearer.
Now Li Ming often tells his friends, "Studying all the time is not the (24) way to learn. Relaxing is (25) important as studying."

items.exp: 作业太多，经常学到半夜。
at night 晚上睡不好。
压力大、睡不好，看起来很累。
表示建议的问句用 something；形容词 new 放在不定代词后面。
be out of breath 上气不接下气。
坚持锻炼，跑得越来越快、越来越久。
not ... any more 不再。
成绩提高的原因是头脑更清醒了，用 because。
一直学习不是最好的学习方法。
as＋原级＋as，放松和学习一样重要。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Sleep Well, Stay Healthy
groups.passage:
How much sleep do you get every night? Doctors say teenagers aged 13 to 18 need 8 to 10 hours of sleep. But many students sleep less than that because of homework, phones and computer games.
Lack of sleep is bad for your health. When you don't sleep enough, you may feel tired and find it hard to pay attention in class. You may also get ill more easily, because your body needs sleep to fight illness.
Here is some advice. First, go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even on weekends. Second, put away your phone at least half an hour before bed. The light from the screen can keep your brain awake. Third, exercise during the day, but not right before bed. Finally, don't drink tea or coffee in the evening.
Good sleep helps you study better and stay healthy. Tonight, why not go to bed a little earlier?

items.stem: How many hours of sleep do teenagers need?
items.exp: teenagers aged 13 to 18 need 8 to 10 hours of sleep。

items.stem: Why may people get ill more easily if they don't sleep enough?
options: Because the body needs sleep to fight illness.
Because they drink too much coffee.
items.exp: because your body needs sleep to fight illness。

items.stem: Why should you put away your phone before bed?
options: Because you need to do homework.
Because your parents don't like it.
Because the light from the screen can keep your brain awake.
items.exp: The light from the screen can keep your brain awake。

items.stem: Which of the following is NOT suggested in the passage?
options: Not drinking coffee in the evening.
Getting up at the same time every day.
items.exp: 原文是 exercise during the day, but not right before bed，睡前不要运动。

items.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why sleep is important and how to sleep well.
items.exp: 先讲睡眠不足的害处，再给出睡好觉的建议。

sections.title: A Letter to Tom
sections.passage:
Dear Tom,
I'm sorry to hear that you often feel (36) (tire) these days. Here is some advice. First, you shouldn't (37) (stay) up late. Try (38) (go) to bed before 10:30. Second, eat (39) (health) food, like fruit and vegetables, instead of junk food. Third, exercise (40) ______ least three times a week. You can play basketball with us after school. It's a great way (41) (relax). Also, don't spend too much time (42) (play) computer games. If you feel (43) (stress), talk to your parents or friends. Remember (44) (drink) enough water every day.
I hope you'll feel (45) (good) soon.
Yours,
Li Hua

items.exp: feel 是系动词，后接形容词；人感到累用 tired。
shouldn't＋动词原形；stay up late 熬夜。
try to do 尽力去做；try doing 尝试做。这里两种都说得通。
修饰名词 food 用形容词 healthy。
at least 至少。
a way to do sth.。
spend time (in) doing sth. 花时间做某事。
人感到有压力用 stressed；stressful 形容事情让人有压力。
remember to do sth. 记得要做某事。
feel better 感觉好些了，用比较级。

sections.prompt:
你的英国笔友 Peter 来信说，最近学习压力很大，晚上睡不好，白天上课没精神。请给他回一封信：1. 对他的情况表示关心；2. 从作息、运动、放松方式等方面提出至少三条建议；3. 鼓励他。要求：80 词左右，开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
Dear Peter,
……
Yours,
Li Hua
points: 提出至少三条具体建议
语言正确（should / had better / why not / try to do 等提建议的句型，动词不定式），书写规范
sections.sample:
Dear Peter,
I'm sorry to hear that you feel stressed and can't sleep well. Here is some advice for you.
First, you should go to bed and get up at the same time every day. You'd better put away your phone half an hour before bed. Second, try to exercise every day. Running or playing basketball is a good way to relax. Third, why not take up a hobby, like drawing or listening to music? It can help you forget your worries for a while. If you still feel stressed, talk to your parents or teachers.
Don't worry too much. I'm sure you'll feel better soon!
Yours,
Li Hua
sections.exp: 写完检查：提建议的句型轮换着用（should / You'd better / Why not ...? / It's a good idea to ...），不要每句都是 You should；should、had better 后接动词原形；“放松的好方法”是 a good way to relax。
